content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text resolves the link by whether a verse's own words state a verdict or contrary, rather than weighing chain against chain by footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"neither text's own words state the other reading's contrary.","rule_words":"the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"\"pressing side's own chain read together\": either the judge text is weighing the defense's cited verses as one chain, so K-C governs, or it is only a one-verse observation, so K-C would not govern.","why":"By making the lack of a verse whose own words state the contrary decisive, the judge text applies the retired stating-verse test instead of weighing the pressed chain against the opposing chain by footing."}
